# TrooCRO

> Barrier-led conversion rate optimisation (CRO) for D2C brands, by Troopod. TrooCRO checks a store against 937 conversion signals and 79 buyer barriers, then Troopod's team and dev agents build the fixes, test them and measure them at 45 and 90 days.

Every page on this site has a Markdown version with the same facts, for agents and AI assistants.

## Pages
- [Home](index.md): what TrooCRO does, how it works, published customer results and how to get started.
- [Free site analysis](analyze.md): run a free analysis of any store page. Score, findings tied to buyer barriers, first tests and a dated plan in about 2 minutes. Start one by opening analyze.html?url=yourstore.com
- [Book a demo](contact.md): talk to the TrooCRO team.

## Offerings
- Barrier-led CRO: find why shoppers drop off and ship tested fixes on the store you already have.
- Campaign landing pages (TrooLaunch): a page for every campaign, audience and offer.
- Ad-to-page personalisation: the page carries on the story the ad started.
- Speed, SEO and AEO (TrooPerformance): faster pages that search engines and AI assistants can read, understand and recommend.

## Published results (Troopod case studies)
- Damensch: +179% conversion rate
- Bombay Shaving Company: 1.5X conversion rate in 30 days
- Gataca: +225% average order value
- Formial Labs: +17% revenue in 30 days
- HomeLane: +13.5% visitor-to-lead in a 50/50 A/B test
